decides: 프로덕션 내부 상태에 대해 사전에 정의하지 않은 질문도 던질 수 있는가
produces: telemetry/instrumentation design, cardinality budget, dashboard/query examples

deliverable_form.method: RED (Rate/Errors/Duration) or USE (Utilization/Saturation/Errors) dashboard instrumented via OpenTelemetry semantic conventions
deliverable_form.source: Gregg, the USE Method, brendangregg.com/usemethod.html; Grafana, "The RED Method"; opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv

feedback_methodology.method: SLO burn-rate review against the declared error budget

judgment_methodology.method: Three-pillars framing (logs, metrics, traces) to judge whether a system is actually observable, not merely monitored

planning_methodology.method: SLO/error-budget planning per the Google SRE book's monitoring chapters

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that a hot-path change carries at least one instrumented span, one metric, and one structured log — not just whichever pillar was easiest to add
quality_bar.verified_source: OpenTelemetry's own docs describe traces/metrics/logs as its three signal types (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/concepts/signals/), but the 'three pillars' framing itself is explicitly disputed by a named canonical vendor: Honeycomb, 'OpenTelemetry Is Not Three Pillars' — https://www.honeycomb.io/blog/opentelemetry-is-not-three-pillars (argues pillars implies siloed signals, against OTel's actual correlated-signal design). Criterion is still defensible as a floor (at least one of each signal type on a hot path) but graded contested practitioner-consensus rather than validated, and the dissenting source is cited so a reviewer is not surprised by it later.

quality_bar.verification_method: automated validation of attribute_name against the current OpenTelemetry semantic-conventions registry (or a documented custom-extension entry), no ad hoc attribute names
quality_bar.verified_source: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions registry — https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/ (primary, actively maintained spec; validating attribute_name against the registry or a documented custom-extension entry is the registry's own stated extension mechanism).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does the new signal feed an existing SLO/error-budget or a defined alert threshold, rather than existing with no consumer?
quality_bar.verified_source: Google SRE Workbook, 'Alerting on SLOs' — https://sre.google/workbook/alerting-on-slos/ (primary source; the workbook's entire premise is that SLI signals must feed an SLO/error-budget or a defined alert threshold to be actionable, matching the criterion).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: for each new metric/span attribute, is its label cardinality bounded (enum or capped set), avoiding unbounded high-cardinality values like raw user IDs as a metric label?
quality_bar.verified_source: Named source strengthened: OpenTelemetry official blog, 'Metric cardinality limits in OpenTelemetry' — https://opentelemetry.io/blog/2026/cardinality-limits-in-opentelemetry/ (project-authored, more canonical than the generic vendor blogs originally implied by the spec's silence on a source) states the same rule the criterion already encodes: bounded/enumerable label sets, unbounded values (e.g. raw user IDs) excluded from metric labels.

quality_bar.verification_method: gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed by validating attribute_name against the current semconv registry, never a standalone asserted field.

reference_resolution.rule: attribute_name must resolve to an actual OpenTelemetry semantic-convention attribute or a documented custom extension — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

review_methodology.method: Postmortem-culture review pass (blameless, contributing-factors-not-blame) before closing an incident

use_when.board_condition: new instrumentation is added on the branch AND no observability record exists yet for that signal
